summary: Based on evidence through March 13, 2018, the borrower’s performance, acquisition completion, and financial outlook align with existing assumptions; no new risks emerge that would justify tightening, loosening, or adding covenants. The current package remains appropriate.

clauses.rationale: Evidence shows EBITDA trending upward and acquisition performed as expected, no indication leverage ratio will breach the scheduled minimum; retain.
Evidence shows timely delivery of FY 2017 financial statements within 90‑day window and ongoing preparation of VIP pro forma statements; retain.
Evidence shows quarterly results disclosed promptly; no delay in quarterly reporting; retain.
Evidence shows monthly reporting practice unchanged; no evidence of missed monthly deadlines; retain.
Evidence shows no material adverse effect disclosed; notices provisions remain adequate; retain.
Evidence shows indebtedness consistent with permitted baskets; no new prohibited borrowing indicated; retain.

drift_reasons: No evidence of changed risk coverage, monitoring needs, or permitted behavior; all assumptions remain supported by the supplied evidence.
